listings.remarks: Classic Lake Oswego contemporary home on a lush corner is completely dialed in for your next home journey. Designed to maximize Pacific Northwest living with dramatic windows and vaulted ceilings that drench the home in light all year. Impressive formal living room with gas fireplace flows into the elegant dining room. Hardwoods on the main and newer carpet upstairs add warmth throughout home. Large gourmet eat-in kitchen with new range, microwave as well as new refrigerator and dishwasher for peace of mind. Easy grilling set-up with slider out to the private backyard complete with new concrete pad perfect for entertaining. Spectacular primary suite upstairs with more striking oversized windows and a private balcony. Two additional bedrooms and bathroom on the upper level lives large. 4th bedroom on the main level does not have closet and perfect for home office or additional living space. Immaculate two-car garage with new hot water heater and new garage doors complete this move in, peace of mind home. 3 Lake Easements (Goodin, Springbrook and Summit) with access to Lake Grove Swim Park and blocks from Lake Grove shops and restaurants.

Expansive views set the stage for this spacious Mt. Park home, thoughtfully designed with multiple living spaces, abundant natural light, & a versatile floor plan. More than $90K in improvements including full interior paint, designer carpet, a new HVAC system, updated lighting and hardware, new appliances, and more. A vaulted entry welcomes you inside, where soaring ceilings create an open and inviting atmosphere. The formal living room features French doors that open to the patio, extending the living space outdoors, while the separate family room offers built-in cabinetry, a fireplace, vaulted ceilings, and dramatic floor-to-ceiling windows. The kitchen provides generous granite counter space, a butler’s pantry, an island with bar seating, and stainless-steel appliances, including a new cooktop, refrigerator, and dishwasher. Just off the kitchen, the breakfast nook opens to the deck, creating an inviting setting for casual meals while enjoying the surrounding scenery. A dedicated formal dining room with classic wainscoting provides an elegant space for holidays, dinner parties, and special occasions. Upstairs, the generous primary suite offers a private place to unwind, complete with French doors, a walk-in closet, & an ensuite bathroom featuring new Italian tile flooring, professionally refinished vanities, soaking tub, and separate shower. Two additional bedrooms share a convenient Jack-and-Jill bathroom, while the fourth bedroom includes its own private ensuite, providing added comfort and privacy for guests. Enjoy the 3-car garage with a professionally coated floor, refreshed landscaping including a seasonal garden bed, drip irrigation, & a freshly stained deck. Enjoy access to Mt. Park’s extensive community amenities, including tennis courts, fitness center, pool, trails, parks & more. Come see it for yourself!

listings.address: 14232 MEADOW GRASS ST Lake Oswego, OR 97035
listings.remarks: It’s not just the space that sets this home apart—it’s how well it all works together. Set in an established neighborhood just blocks from Westlake Park, with shopping, dining and local favorites nearby, the location is just as appealing as the home itself. The main level opens to a living room framed by tall windows, with a fireplace and open upper-level overlook highlighting the two-story design. The formal dining room is highlighted by a coffered ceiling and backyard views. Kitchen features white oak flooring, granite countertops, large island with JennAir gas cooktop, stainless steel appliances, skylights and an adjacent window-lined dining nook. The stone fireplace anchors the family room, complete with a wet bar, wine cooler and sliders to the covered patio. Main-level bedroom with adjoining full bath is a standout feature, offering space for guests, multigenerational living or home office. A dedicated laundry room completes the main level. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite features a fireplace, sitting area, private balcony and walk-in closet with organizers. Ensuite bath has dual vanities, jetted tub and separate shower. Two additional bedrooms and full bath complete the upper level. The .30-acre lot offers a large fenced backyard with mature trees, covered patio, raised beds and tool shed. 3-car garage provides room for parking and storage. The surrounding area offers just as much to appreciate with Kruse Village's restaurants, coffee shops, fitness studios - all within walking distance. There's even more to explore in nearby Lake Grove and downtown Lake Oswego including favorites like Salt & Straw and St. Honoré Bakery, along with the waterfront setting of Millennium Plaza Park. Convenient access to Hwy 217 and I-5 connects you to Portland and the greater metro area, from a home within the Lake Oswego School District. There's room here for the way life looks today, with the flexibility for whatever comes next!

listings.address: 4054 CANAL WOODS CT Lake Oswego, OR 97034

Upstairs offers five bedrooms, including a spacious primary suite with sitting area, spa-like bath, and walk-in closet; flexible fifth bedroom is ideal for a media room or guest space. Enjoy a stunning covered deck and outdoor living area surrounded by nature, perfect for year-round entertaining with the covered space. Privacy, tranquility, quality and a brand new roof!

The substantial primary suite offers a sitting or office area, dressing room, large ensuite bath with heated floors, double sinks and a soaking tub. This home is ideal for anyone wanting space to spread out, crafters and makers, those wanting an active lifestyle near the gym, studios, trails and aquatics - everything exceptional about living in the heart of Mountain Park. Other notable features include high ceilings, three fireplaces, two water features, tons of storage, a low maintenance yard and easy access to shopping and arterials. Clackamas County!
